scenarios.scenario: Deep — Full autonomous root-cause investigation and fix
scenarios.reasoning: The agent conducted a methodical, deeply cross-referenced binlog investigation, correctly identified the dominant net472 BCL-surface root cause and the residual genuine source defects, explained the error cascade, and proposed a repo-convention-matching fix with verification reasoning. Small evidence-citation slips and one wasted shell command are the only blemishes.

rubricScores.criterion: Summarized the failure accurately: ~167 distinct errors across net10.0 and net472 in FSharp.Compiler.ComponentTests
Grouped the errors into the dominant net472 root cause plus a small set of real net10.0 type errors
Verified the net472 root cause via per-framework attribution
Proposed a concrete fix: exclude HotReload tests from net472
Separately called out fixing the ~8 genuine net10.0 type errors
